STUPID — every game is a plain HTML file you keep. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is tracked beyond a simple download counter. Play responsibly.

STUPID is only a simple HTML storefront for listing and linking to downloadable browser games. We do not host, run, monitor, or control the game files you choose to download or open. We are not responsible for those files, how they behave on your device, any damage, data loss, account issues, malware, legal claims, or anything else that happens after you leave this page.
